text:
marie: Quick check — I ran nsys + torch.profiler on the small-window prefetched batch (batch=8, seq=512, prefetch=2) and there's a KV cache miss spike around step ~220. Attaching traces: s3://redwood-traces/1967894321-prefetch.nsys.tar.gz. Anyone able to eyeball?

alex: I can't open that link (403). Can you paste the nsys capture filename and the torch.prof command you used? Also which CUDA/image/kernel? :eyes:

marie: upload bot said it finished, but here are the commands:
```bash
NSYS_LOGFILE=trace_prefetch nsys profile --sample=none --trace=nvtx,cuda --output=trace_prefetch nsys_cmd ...
python -m torch.profiler --activities CPU CUDA --profile_memory --record_shapes script.py
```
Torch snippet:
```py
with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.CUDA], record_shapes=True):
    model(prefetch_batch)
```
Running on p4d (CUDA 12.1, cuDNN 9.2). Prefetch implemented in our DataLoader with num_workers=2, prefetch_to_device=True.

david: can you run a quick 5-step ablation: batch=1, prefetch=0 vs prefetch=2, capture flamegraphs? My hunch: prefetch thread is racing and evicting KV entries in the shared cache.

marie: good call — kicked off short runs now. FYI torch.prof timeline shows repetitive 'kv_cache_lookup' events with ~40ms tail in the prefetch case.

sre-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-traces/1967894321-prefetch-flamegraphs.tar.gz

alex: grabbing the flamegraph. Quick observation: big spike in memcpy H2D around the same interval. Are we prefetching on host and doing large host->device copies?

marie: we prefetch host tensors then pin and copy async. Config excerpt:
```yaml
prefetch_to_device: true
pin_memory: true
copy_async: true
```

sophia: @marie @alex if memcpy H2D tails are high that can trigger evictions and KV misses. Try disabling pin+async to test.

marie: agreed — running an ablation: pin_memory=false, copy_async=false, prefetch_to_device=true. ETA ~6m.

alex: also enable record_shapes=True and a short torchprof run so we can see if tensor sizes change mid-epoch.

marie: done. Short logs attached. Result: with pin_memory=false KV miss spikes drop ~70% and latency is slightly higher but much more stable.

david: promising. Next step: add a small in-flight bytes guard in prefetch (semaphore) to cap total H2D bytes and re-run full workload.

marie: will prototype semaphore in DataLoader prefetch loop and open a PR. CC @sophia for review.

sophia: happy to review — include a minimal reproducer and before/after flamegraphs please.

marie: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-runtime/pull/4321 — includes test, perf notes, and CI.

alex: left a small nit around semaphore await ordering, otherwise LGTM. :+1:

marie: thanks — merging after green CI.

sre-bot: CI passed for PR #4321

marie: follow-up: post-merge toy runs on p4d show KV miss spike eliminated. Closing the loop. I'll queue a regression bench run tomorrow to validate at scale. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)
